responsibility: Provides GCC’s null implementation of the generic debug hook interface declared in debug.h. This file defines do_nothing_debug_hooks and the companion stub callbacks for compilation-unit setup, source lines, blocks, functions, declarations, imported entities, labels, variable locations, and inline events, giving the compiler a stable no-op debug backend to use when no real debug format writer is active or when debug services must be safely disabled.
same_name_distinction: Supplies one concrete implementation of the generic debug hook API from debug.h: the no-op do_nothing_debug_hooks table and stub callbacks. Unlike debug.h, it does not define the abstract hook contract or declare other format backends; it only implements the null backend.
